description: Hand-authored, schema-faithful OpenCode terminal message shape for a quota refusal. Nothing here was captured: the id and timestamp are fabricated placeholders, and the error class and message reproduce OpenCode's own AI.Error.QuotaExceeded wording. No session, account, host, usage event, or operational feed data is represented.

error.message: AI.Error: Free usage limit reached. Subscribe to OpenCode Go to keep going: https://opencode.ai/go
